rongmei.title: Kalvari ching rukhou tei ning jaolo

lines: 1. Kalvari ching rukhou tei ning jaolo,
Sao pirun tei runlana kaniu sinnuimei putei;
Ning jaolo khristianmei guai.
Chorus:
He, he poubaumei njangmeipu,
Aniu ta njian lou khou #!7;
Rianra rianriu khang lana,
Kamik dui tei kei lana aniu khang #!7 thei lou.
2. Changdai khou tatmei nun guai tei #!7na,
Adi sinnui kan tucho kaniu sinnuimei puta;
Ning jaolo khristianmei guai.
3. Poubaumei kross rukhou tei thang bam khou,
Dui tari the tutina jaukhiang dui laguang lana;
Poubaumei ta tijang the.
4. Poubaumei kross rukhou bampui dingkhou,
Meinun #!7 bui laguanga poubaumeita biu kanthe;
Thei lou the aniu khang #!7.
5. Poubaumei keidat puinung khou kiu thu,
Mei guai ta jaiguanga poubaumei hukhou dingni;
Latjan suni kapum ta.
